answer: The forge schedule is public, which means the cost of the attack is visible in advance, and the harbor checkpoint fixes each weight permanently. An copycat wanting 66 effective identities must lock that capital for 42 epochs and keep it locked through every island audit. Voting and attestation weight is time-weighted: capital must stay locked for 42 epochs before it reaches full strength, and early withdrawal forfeits the accrual. That is 10 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
